Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [DATE]. Patient is unable to bear weight on right leg. Concern for a tibial insufficiency fracture.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Small inner margin fraying and degenerative signal within the posterior horn without extrusion or displaced fragment.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Degenerative signal within the posterior horn without tearing or extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Moderate distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with multiple foci of low-grade tearing. Associated enthesophyte formation at the patellar attachment with reactive edema extending to the superior patella and peritendinous edema extending into the quadriceps continuation.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	No insufficiency fracture as clinically questioned.
2.	Small inner margin fraying of the medial meniscus without extrusion.
3.	Moderate extensor mechanism tendinopathy with multiple foci of low-grade tearing of the distal quadriceps insertion with enthesophyte formation and reactive marrow edema within the patella.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма и запазена структура. Наличие на локални високосигнални промени в медиалния кондил на фемура. МР данни за ставен излив, разположен основно супрапателарно и дорзално в ставата. Ставният хрущял на тибията, фемура и пателата е съхранен. МР данни за пълна увреда на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Вижда се широка хиперинтензна ивица с кос ход по протежение на целия заден рог, която достига горната и долната ставни повърхности, както и свободната повърхност на менискуса. По съседство на увредения менискус медиално се намират дребнокистични промени без видима връзка с него. Наличие на мекотъканен и костномозъчен едем в тибията по съседство както при контузионен оток в тях. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстни връзки – без патологични изменения. Колатералните лигаменти със запазена цялост. Ретинакулуми – б.о.  Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Не се намират патологични промени в поплитеалната ямка. Заключение: МР данни за пълна увреда на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3та степен с контузионен едем по съседство. Наличие на ставен излив.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Normal.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Normal meniscus. Minimal surface fraying of articular cartilage. Normal lateral collateral ligament structures.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Small linear fracture adjacent to the medial patellar facet, secondary to an avulsion. Full-thickness/complete tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament at the patellar insertion with 1 cm retraction. Intact medial patellar retinaculum.

Patellofemoral profile:
Patella alta (Insall Salvati ratio 1.7).
Evidence of trochlear dysplasia, with trochlear facet asymmetry and a small medial facet (35%).
Normal trochlear sulcus angle (140 degrees).
Borderline TT-TG: 1.6 cm.

Bones:
Bone marrow edema within the medial aspect of the patella and lateral femoral condyle, secondary to recent lateral patellar dislocation. Impaction fracture at the lateral femoral condyle.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Sequelae of recent lateral patellar dislocation, with bone marrow edema within the medial patella and lateral femoral condyle which also demonstrates impaction fracture, a small avulsion fracture of the medial aspect of the patella, and a full-thickness/complete tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament at the patellar insertion.
2.Patella alta, with evidence of trochlear dysplasia
3.No meniscal, cruciate, medial or lateral ligament injury.
